asof_static_audit.depth_sampling: recorded_at inside current bin only; no cross-bin carry

integrity.residual_half_life_caveat: v3 computes persistence after dropping missing residual observations, so non-adjacent valid bins can become adjacent. Do not use v3 half-life as an exact time-constant claim without a gap-aware recheck; Lane A does not elevate it to a core finding.
terminology_issues: contemporaneous metric label 'ofi_imbalance' is implemented as full-depth imbalance change, not aggressor/order-flow imbalance
market_universe exclusion label '*_NOT_ASSESSED_USABLE' means the frozen regime-specific usable flag was not true; do not read it as ELECTION_DAY-style eligibility-not-assessed
